name: Mixed-use shop and flats
description: Three-storey corner-plot building, 13 x 12 m: a glazed shopfront in a dark-grey rendered ground floor with a blank fascia sign panel and a steel canopy, two floors of flats in brick slip above with tall windows and glass Juliet balconies, a parapet roof with plant. Enterable: the shop with a fixed counter, a rear stair corridor with two stairs, and a flat on each upper floor (kitchen, living room and bedroom).
